novelData.title: QCAT Fixture Three
novelData.storyArc: A synthetic three-chapter fixture for the QCAT harness self-test.
novelData.generalPlot: Short, replay, and clean chapters with planted metrics.

characters.name: Elena Voss
characters.backstory: Lead observer on the lunar hub.

subplots: The ice haul vector must stay red until the habitat vote.
novelData.novelOutline: Three synthetic chapters only. No book text from production sessions belongs here.
novelData.plotOutline: Ch1 is short. Ch2 replays its first half. Ch3 is clean.
chapterOutlines: Elena Voss stands at the lunar hub and counts bolts. Bastian Kane logs the bus. The scene is a stub so length fails.
Elena Voss walks the gallery rail. Bastian Kane names the ice haul vector. The second half copies the first half on purpose.
Elena Voss and Bastian Kane finish the watch on the lunar hub without repeating a forty-word span or stacking did-not tics.

chapterBlueprints.dialogueTurn: Elena Voss asks Bastian Kane whether the cryogenic bus still holds.

chapterBlueprints.turnOrPayoff: The stub ends before any payoff; length is the planted fail.

chapterBlueprints.arcStep: A single clean watch with named cast and setting and no replay seam.

chapterBlueprints.dialogueTurn: Elena Voss tells Bastian Kane the lunar hub watch is closed.
chapterBlueprints.sensoryWorldHook: Warm glove leather on the gallery rail and a single pump tick.
chapterBlueprints.turnOrPayoff: They close the watch; no second pass of the same walk.
